entries.query: Modify the description prompt by changing only the character to a white‑haired boy. Keep everything else exactly the same as before, and describe every facial detail as thoroughly as possible. The clothing should remain the same style, but adapted into a male version. Optimize the prompt specifically for Gemini 3 Image aka Nano Banana Pro—check the model architecture requirements to achieve the most ultra‑realistic, state‑of‑the‑art quality.
entries.answer:
Here is a revised prompt that changes only the character into a white-haired boy, keeps the original scene and styling intact, and is structured to fit the Nano Banana / Gemini 3 Pro schema shown in your attached spec. The schema explicitly supports fields like `meta`, `subject`, `scene`, `technical`, `composition`, and `advanced`, with options such as `quality`, `guidance_scale`, `input_image`, detailed `hair`, layered `clothing`, and a negative prompt list, so I optimized the prompt around that structure rather than writing a loose cinematic paragraph.[1]

## Facial detail block

If you want the face described even more aggressively for identity locking, append this exact text into the `description` field of the subject. The schema allows a long natural-language visual trait description inside `subject.description`, so this is the best place to push facial specificity.[1]

```json
{
  "facial_detail_expansion": "Face must be highly detailed and ultra-realistic, matching the attached reference identity: a young white-haired boy with a long, narrow, symmetrical face; tall forehead; cool pale skin with a smooth natural texture; subtle under-eye shadows; slim temples; sharp cheekbones; hollowed mid-cheek area; lean jawline tapering to a narrow chin; straight, slender nose bridge with a refined nose tip; thin to medium lips with a defined cupid's bow and slightly fuller lower lip; large almond-shaped dark brown eyes with a steady, intense, slightly tired gaze; visible upper eyelids; softly shadowed lower lids; straight, dark, well-defined eyebrows with a gentle angular arch; close-set facial harmony with elegant proportions; clean-shaven face; no beard; no mustache; ears small and close to the head; platinum-white hair with cool icy undertones, thick and softly voluminous, brushed upward and back with a polished, airy texture. Preserve the youthful male structure exactly: slim neck, narrow shoulders, delicate but masculine facial anatomy, editorial beauty, realistic pores, realistic skin microtexture, realistic light falloff, realistic eye reflections, and natural lip texture."
}
```

## What changed

Only the character was changed from a glamorous blonde woman to a glamorous white-haired boy, while the setting, nightlife mood, phone call action, champagne flute, black outfit concept, sparkling waist detail, indoor window backdrop, flash-lit photography look, and overall composition remain intentionally the same. The clothing was adapted into a male version by preserving the black fitted sleeveless silhouette and jeweled waist emphasis, but translating it into tailored menswear styling instead of a dress.[1]

## Best Nano Banana settings

Your attached schema indicates that `ultra_photorealistic` is the intended highest-fidelity quality mode, while higher `steps` increase detail and `guidance_scale` controls prompt obedience, with roughly 7 to 10 being the balanced-to-strict range. Based on that schema alone, the safest high-realism setup is `quality: ultra_photorealistic`, `steps: 50 to 70`, `guidance_scale: 8 to 10`, `magic_prompt_enhancer: true`, `hdr_mode: true`, and a strong `face_id` input strength around 0.9 when identity preservation matters.[1]

I could not verify any separate public “Gemini 3 Image architecture requirements” page from the web in this turn, so I am grounding the optimization in the schema document you attached rather than claiming undocumented architecture facts.[1]
